# Avatar Component

### Avatar

**Exports:**
- `Avatar` - Main avatar component
- `AvatarGroup` - Group of stacked avatars
- `AvatarWithIcon` - Avatar centered around an icon snippet
- `AvatarProps`, `AvatarMember`, `AvatarGroupProps`, `AvatarWithIconProps` - types

**Props:**

**Avatar**
- `size`: number (default: 32)
- `src`: string - Direct image URL
- `username`: string - Used for pravatar.cc fallback URL and title
- `letter`: string - 1–2 uppercase characters shown when no image resolves
- `placeholder`: boolean - Loading shell
- `title`: string - Accessible title for the entity
- `class`: ClassValue

**AvatarGroup**
- `members`: `AvatarMember[]` (required)
- `size`: number (default: 32)
- `limit`: number - Maximum visible avatars; remaining become a +N badge
- `reverse`: boolean - Put the last member on top
- `overlap`: `'auto' | number` - Stacking overlap
- `class`: ClassValue

**AvatarWithIcon**
- `size`: number (default: 32)
- `icon`: Snippet (required)
- `iconBackground`: boolean - Fill a subtle background
- `class`: ClassValue

**Usage:**
```svelte
<script lang="ts">
	import { Avatar, AvatarGroup, AvatarWithIcon } from 'kampsy-ui';
	import { ArrowUpCircle } from '@lucide/svelte';

	const members = [
		{ username: 'evilrabbit' },
		{ username: 'severinlandolt' },
		{ username: 'rauchg' },
	];
</script>

<div class="flex items-center gap-4">
	<Avatar username="evilrabbit" size={32} />
	<AvatarGroup {members} size={32} limit={4} />
	<Avatar letter="SL" size={32} />
	<AvatarWithIcon size={32} iconBackground>
		{#snippet icon()}<ArrowUpCircle />{/snippet}
	</AvatarWithIcon>
</div>
```

## Installation

```bash
pnpm i -D kampsy-ui@latest
```

## Documentation

Visit http://ui.kampsy.xyz/avatar for full documentation and examples.
